source: Resettable isolated S32K148 calibration: existing mixed and automotive validation, sequential-memory and integer arithmetic sweeps, true/false branch-evaluation sweeps, and variable bitwise/shift sweeps. AND, OR, and XOR each measured 0.375 us/operation; left and right variable shifts each measured 0.416666667 us/operation. Every sweep uses 16, 64, 256, and 1024 training units plus a held-out 640-unit point with zero interpolation error. A cumulative memory-plus-integer-plus-branch automotive task measured 306.500 us versus a 281.808 us raw prediction and a 309.989 us margin-adjusted admission estimate. A 10% engineering margin is applied to admission estimates. This is not a WCET certificate.
